Notice To Reestablish the Transit Advisory Committee for Safety Charter
articles.summary: The Federal Transit Administration (FTA) announces the reestablishment of the charter of the Transit Advisory Committee for Safety (TRACS). The previous TRACS charter expired on February 2, 2026. The U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and FTA are committed to ensuring the safety of the Nation's public transportation systems and reducing safety risks to both riders and transit workers. Accordingly, the Secretary of Transportation (Secretary) has determined that reestablishing TRACS is necessary and in the public interest.
